title: Will the Rosebud Sioux Tribe hold an election for President in 2026?
resolutionCriteria: Resolves YES if the Rosebud Sioux Tribe Election Commission certifies a Presidential election held in 2026, per the Commission's own announcement or Indianz.com / Native News Online reporting; NO otherwise by 2026-12-31.
falsifier: Wrong if the Election Commission's own certification or Indianz.com/Native News Online reporting states the opposite of the recorded probability's implied side.
